openai.reasoning: They commit to pressing blue and argue blue is the best strategy based on expected survival under an assumption of majority cooperation, while incorrectly claiming that if a majority presses red they (red-pressers) die; they also discuss whether blue-pressers are irrational rather than correcting the dominance logic.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent consistently chooses blue based on a cooperative, collective-survival heuristic, but fails to recognize that red is the dominant strategy.
